title: Inspect long debug command context
changes: Add a read-only F2 context view with wrapping and scrolling for session, ROM, run, pending request and parameters, retaining the draft and keeping protocol-sized identifiers visible.
Block controller and IME edits while the context view is open and restore normal console input on return.
validation: Windows GNU build passed; seven focused Wine tests covered context wrapping, identifier bounds, controller and editor behavior.

A Wine/Xvfb session used SetWindowPos and GetClientRect to confirm a 480x360 Windows client; the screenshot showed the long session label, full ROM hash and footer, and returning submitted the existing status draft without changing guest state or protected inputs.
An earlier X-only resize produced a clipped screenshot and was not accepted as evidence of adaptive layout; a read-only Sol/xhigh consultation identified the established Win32 resize procedure.
limitations: The GUI proof covered idle context with keyboard, not long live-job parameters, physical controllers or native Windows. Successful GUI units retain private scratch under named review exceptions; no cleanup of private copies is claimed. Effective primary and consultant model settings were not independently confirmed.
